title: Same word, any case
prompt: Return true if a and b are the same word ignoring capital letters, so "Godot" and "GODOT" match.
starter:
func solve(a, b):
	return a == b
hints: Make both the same case before comparing.

docs.name: text.to_upper() / text.to_lower()
docs.what: Returns the text in capitals, or in small letters.

solution:
func solve(a, b):
	return a.to_lower() == b.to_lower()
